fusions.name: Flaking Shelf
fusions.desc: Scales of fungus shed in a ring, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning each for 1 second, slowing it 10% and stripping 15% of its armour for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shelf Fragments
fusions.desc: Hurls a shard of bracket fungus that bursts on impact, dealing 32 damage and leaving the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Every other enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 80% of that damage.

fusions.name: Curled Colony
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds and your poison resistance by 20% for as long as it lasts.

fusions.name: Lichen Plating
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10% and you regenerate 1 health a second.
